text:
zoe: intake alert  full bench + comp checks are stalling deploys. thinking: "rapid-accept" path using a tiny prober to let low-risk models into canary faster.

rahul: curious what "low-risk" means operationally. detail pls.

maria: sketch: 1) artifact -> ops manifest w/ per-op hash 2) run prober (30-90s): op-diff microbench + 20 golden seeds + few tail microtraces 3) compatibility smoke 4) if pass -> provisional_accept and schedule full bench async.

devon: important: prober must include KV warmup traces and a long-seq case. op-list equality alone will miss packing/quant issues.

kyle: tiers: internal -> rapid; quick -> provisional + full bench in 12h; strict -> block until full bench. customers opt into tiers or based on SLA.

rahul: thresholds: use relative deltas vs family baseline (e.g., p95 > +10% -> fail). also cap absolute prober runtime.

maria: state machine: ingested -> prober -> provisional|blocked -> full-bench-scheduled -> accepted|rejected. transitions are auditable with reason codes.

devon: rollback automation: registry keeps last-known-good. if full bench later fails, auto-roll and open high-priority alert.

kyle: quota model: accelerated full-bench slots for purchase; otherwise users fall into deferred pool. avoids resource spam.

zoe: security: op-hash uses sha256 over canonical op descriptor. store only hashes to avoid leaking internals.

maria: UI signals: show "provisional" with TTL and link to pending bench job; metrics: prober_passrate, prober_latency, false-positive-rate. aim FP <1%.

bench-bot: backlog snapshot: full-bench queue x3 last night; avg full-bench = 47m; prober target = 45-90s.

zoe: action items: kyle owns golden-set mapping and quota; maria drafts RFC update (ops schema + state machine + rollback playbook); devon prototypes prober microtraces. PRs in a week.

rahul: sounds good. ping #eng-ml when PRs are up. :rocket:
